rationale.overall: B reads closer to the REFERENCE's clean volumetric block with a crisp glowing underline, while A muddies the same form with a dark brown-grey haze and a washed-out top face that flattens the object.
rationale.material: B's top surface holds a believable graduated sheen with a distinct cool-to-dark falloff and a clean specular edge, whereas A's material is smoky and blotchy with a dull grey wash that loses the stone-like density of the REFERENCE.
rationale.silhouette: Both share the same wedge-plus-ribbon layout, but B's block has sharper, more consistent edge definition and a cleaner separation from the ground plane, while A's lower-left corner and front face blur into the background value.
rationale.smallsize: At 32px and 16px B keeps a legible dark bar with a bright orange accent line, while A's bar collapses toward mid-grey and the accent reads weaker against the background.
